mode_low_power_desc: Quiet and efficient: less noise and heat, longer battery life.
mode_balanced_desc: Sweet spot for everyday work with moderate fan noise.
mode_performance_desc: Maximum power for gaming and heavy workloads.
mode_dynamic_desc: AMD kernel mode (amd-pstate-epp): the CPU dynamically balances speed and efficiency based on workload and power source.
overview_sub: Everything important about your laptop at a glance
tip_toggle_camera: Enables or disables the built-in webcam at the USB level.
tip_toggle_mic: Mutes or unmutes the default microphone.
tip_toggle_wifi: Turns Wi-Fi on or off via NetworkManager.
tip_toggle_bluetooth: Powers the Bluetooth adapter on or off.
journal_empty: Nothing yet. Profile and mode switches with reasons will appear here.
problems_none_text: All laptop features known to DOCKIT are working.
problems_some_text: Some features are unavailable. See Diagnostics for details and fixes.
perf_sub: Performance mode, fine tuning, and live system load
tip_turbo_boost: Boosts CPU clocks above base speed under load. Turn off for lower heat, noise, and longer battery life.
epp_tip: Hint for the CPU scheduler: prioritize speed or battery life.
epp_unavailable: This CPU setting is not available on this laptop.
gpu_limit_tip: Lower wattage means cooler and quieter operation, with lower gaming FPS.
gpu_limit_unavailable: This laptop's GPU has a fixed power limit locked by the vendor.
top_cpu_empty: No process is heavily using the CPU right now.
top_cpu_note: 100 % equals one CPU thread (multi-threaded apps can exceed 100 %).
bat_sub: Charge level, battery health, brightness, and refresh rate
brightness_missing: Backlight control was not found. Use the laptop's Fn keys.
refresh_tip: Lower Hz saves battery; higher Hz feels smoother.
refresh_missing: Refresh rate switching works on niri, Hyprland, Sway, KDE Plasma, and X11.
charge_limit_unavail: The kernel does not expose a charge limit on this model yet — set it in BIOS or GiMATE (Windows).
cool_sub: Temperatures, overheating alerts, graphs, and fans
cool_hot_msg: Temperature is above {t} °C. Switch to Balanced or Quiet and check airflow.
throttling_cpu_tip: The CPU is lowering its clock speed due to high temperature.
throttling_gpu_tip: The GPU is lowering its clock speed due to high temperature.
sensors_missing: No temperature sensors found. Install lm_sensors and run sensors-detect.
fans_missing: The kernel does not report fan speeds on this laptop. Fan curve follows the performance mode.
periph_sub: Volume, audio devices, Bluetooth, and USB peripherals
audio_profiles_hint: To switch audio automatically for games or calls, set devices in Profiles.
usb_unknown_tip: Not in the database yet (see devices/ folder).
kbd_missing_text: Keyboard backlight was not found via HID LampArray or /sys/class/leds.
kbd_mode_tip: DOCKIT sets the chosen color and brightness. Built-in hands control back to the keyboard's own firmware.
kbd_auto_hint: Backlight is currently controlled by the keyboard's own firmware. Switch to DOCKIT (color) to pick a color and brightness here.
kbd_color_tip: Click a swatch or enter a HEX code (e.g. #5AB0FF).
kbd_need_service: Running DOCKIT service is required to control backlight (sudo scripts/install-dev.sh).
kbd_lamparray_tip: Standard USB HID LampArray (RGB) — controlled directly via the DOCKIT service.
kbd_led_tip: Standard Linux kernel LED brightness interface (/sys/class/leds).
periph_bat_none: No peripheral batteries detected. Supported sources: Bluetooth, UPower / HID++ (Logitech, gamepads), and headsets via headsetcontrol.
periph_bat_tip: Some 2.4 GHz gaming USB dongles hide battery level behind a proprietary protocol — if your device supports Bluetooth, connecting via Bluetooth usually exposes it.
prof_sub: Flip the switches you need — switched-off items stay untouched
new_profile_tip: Name a profile (e.g. Movie or Study) and click +.
delete_tip: Delete this custom profile and its rules. Built-in profiles cannot be deleted.
tab_settings_tip: What this profile changes when activated
tab_rules_tip: When this profile activates automatically in Auto mode
prof_power_tip: Switches the laptop's performance mode when this profile activates.
prof_cam_tip: Enables or hardware-disables the built-in webcam.
prof_out_tip: Switches the default playback device (speakers, headset, etc.).
prof_out_unplugged: This device is currently unplugged — audio will stay unchanged when applying.
prof_in_unplugged: This microphone is currently unplugged — the current one will stay active.
prof_rates_missing: No refresh rates found in the current desktop environment.
rules_intro: Active when Scenario is set to Auto on Overview. If multiple conditions are enabled, all of them must match.
rule_app_tip: Activates automatically while any listed process is running.
rule_app_input_tip: Process name (supports wildcards: steam_app_* matches any Steam game).
pick_running_tip: Lists currently open user apps — click any to add it.
rule_power_tip: Triggers when running on battery or plugged into AC.
rule_idle_tip: Activates when keyboard and mouse are idle for the chosen duration.
rule_temp_tip: Evaluated with highest priority when CPU reaches this temperature.
rule_hours_tip: Restricts the rule to specific hours (supports overnight ranges).
fallback_desc: For example after closing a game or plugging in — Auto mode switches to this profile.
diag_sub: What works on this laptop, what doesn't, and how to fix it
copy_report_tip: Copies feature status and system info to paste into a bug report.
diag_all_good_text: No issues found — every supported feature is working.
install_tip: Installs packages: {pkgs}. Will ask for password.
load_log_tip: Load the last 40 lines of the DOCKIT service journal.
settings_sub: Window behavior, language, appearance, and about
notifications_tip: Desktop alerts for profile switches and overheating (needs libnotify).
autostart_tip: Launch DOCKIT automatically after login. On Hyprland you can also use exec-once = dockit gui.
tray_setting: Tray icon, close minimizes to tray
tray_tip: Hides the window to the system tray with quick mode and camera controls.
compact_nav_tip: Keeps a narrow icon rail on the left even on wide windows.
language_desc: Switches immediately without restarting the window.
accent_desc: Color of active buttons, switches, and graphs — match your Hyprland theme.
about_desc: Open-source Linux laptop control panel. Tested on Gigabyte Gaming A16 3VH (CachyOS / Hyprland).
tip_bat_health: Remaining full-charge capacity vs. design capacity. 90–100% is great; below 80% means noticeable wear.
tip_bat_cycles: Total full charge/discharge cycles. Laptop batteries typically last 500–1000 cycles.
tip_bat_power: Current power draw (on battery) or charging wattage. Idle draw is usually 8–18 W.
tip_cpu_card: Live CPU clock speed, total load across threads, and package temperature.
tip_gpu_card: Discrete GPU clock, load, temperature, and power draw. While asleep, nvidia-smi is never called.
tip_charge_limit: Capping charge at 80% extends battery lifespan when plugged in most of the time.
gpu_sleep_asleep_tip: The GPU is in D3 sleep and uses no battery.
gpu_sleep_never_tip: The kernel keeps the GPU always on (power/control = on). See ArchWiki → PRIME → RTD3 to enable sleep.
gpu_sleep_held_tip: Held awake by: {holders}. Close unneeded apps so the GPU can sleep and save battery.
gpu_sleep_free_tip: The GPU is active and will sleep automatically once idle.
report_copied: Report copied. You can paste it into a bug report or GitHub issue.
mod_service_ok: Service is running, settings can be changed.
mod_service_setup: Service is not running: settings are view-only.
mod_service_hint: Install the service: sudo scripts/install-dev.sh (from the project folder).
mod_power_profile_ok: Mode can be switched via the DOCKIT service.
mod_power_profile_setup: Mode can be read, but changing it requires the DOCKIT service.
mod_power_profile_no: Kernel does not expose performance modes for this model.
mod_power_profile_hint_no: Try a newer kernel. Fallback: power-profiles-daemon and ryzenadj.
mod_power_profile_hint_setup: Install and start the DOCKIT service: sudo scripts/install-dev.sh.
mod_sensors_ok_fans: Temperatures and fan speeds are available.
mod_sensors_ok_nofans: Temperatures are available. Kernel does not report fan speeds.
mod_gpu_nvidia_ok_asleep: GPU is asleep and not draining battery.
mod_gpu_nvidia_setup: NVIDIA GPU detected, but nvidia-smi is missing or the driver is not loaded.
mod_gpu_nvidia_hint: Install the NVIDIA driver (nvidia-open and nvidia-utils) and reboot.
mod_battery_no: Battery not found or charge unreadable.
mod_battery_limit_ok: Charge limit can be read and changed.
mod_battery_limit_setup: Charge limit is visible, but write permission is missing (udev rule needed).
mod_battery_limit_no: Kernel does not expose a charge limit for this model.
mod_battery_limit_hint_no: Update the kernel or check whether the driver supports your model.
mod_battery_limit_hint_setup: Add a udev rule granting write access to charge_control_end_threshold.
mod_camera_ok: Camera can be switched on and off.
mod_camera_setup: Camera found, but switching requires the DOCKIT service.
mod_camera_no: Camera not found among known devices (devices/ database).
mod_camera_hint: Install and start the DOCKIT service: sudo scripts/install-dev.sh.
mod_wireless_no: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth switches not found.
mod_wireless_hint: Check that Wi-Fi and Bluetooth drivers are loaded (command: rfkill list).
mod_audio_hint: Install PipeWire and libpulse: sudo pacman -S pipewire pipewire-pulse libpulse
mod_kbd_backlight_setup: Backlight found ({names}, {mode}), but controlling it requires the DOCKIT service.
mod_kbd_backlight_no: Backlight not exposed via HID LampArray or /sys/class/leds.
mod_kbd_backlight_hint_setup: Install and start the DOCKIT service: sudo scripts/install-dev.sh.
toast_autostart_on: Autostart enabled. If the window does not appear on login, add exec-once = dockit gui to Hyprland or spawn-at-startup "dockit" "gui" to niri
log_read_err: Could not read log (journalctl is required).
toast_log_load_first: Click Refresh first to load the service log
toast_install_unavail: Automatic installation is not available on this system
toast_install_done: Installed: {pkgs}. Restart DOCKIT if the feature does not appear yet.
toast_install_err: Installation failed (cancelled or no internet connection).
toast_profile_saved_dirty: Profile “{name}” saved. Click Apply changes to update.
toast_profile_created: Profile “{name}” created. Configure it on the right.
toast_profile_create_err: Could not create profile (name must be 1–30 characters)
toast_refresh_unsupported: Refresh rate: not supported in this desktop environment
notify_overheat_body: Temperature reached {t} °C. Consider switching to Balanced or Quiet.
proc_desc_gamescope: Gamescope — micro-compositor for games with resolution/FPS control.
proc_desc_gamemoded: GameMode — tunes system settings for gaming.
proc_desc_heroic: Heroic — Epic and GOG game launcher.
proc_desc_wine: Wine — runs Windows apps and games.
proc_desc_wildcard: Pattern: matches any process named like {name}.
proc_desc_generic: Process “{name}”. The rule matches while it is running.
err_polkit_quiet: Password confirmation required: apply the profile manually.
welcome_sub: DOCKIT scanned your system and honestly shows what works on this machine and what won't be available
welcome_recheck_tip: Re-open the first-run overview of supported and unsupported features on this PC.
welcome_desktop_no_battery: This is a desktop PC — there is no battery; the tab will show display controls only.
welcome_dynamic_ok: Supported by your AMD CPU (amd-pstate-epp) — Dynamic mode is enabled.
welcome_dynamic_intel: This kernel mode is currently AMD-only (amd-pstate-epp). Standard Intel EPP presets still work.
welcome_dynamic_no: Kernel does not expose dynamic EPP (requires an AMD CPU with amd-pstate-epp on a recent Linux kernel).
charge_limit_tip: Caps maximum battery charge to extend battery lifespan when plugged in.
charge_limit_need_service: Running DOCKIT service is required to change the charge limit (sudo scripts/install-dev.sh).
report_github_tip: Copies a detailed Markdown report (no personal data) and opens a new GitHub Issue.
toast_report_github_opened: Report copied — opening GitHub Issues, just press Ctrl+V
wizard_hello_sub: Open-source Linux laptop & PC control panel. Pick your preferred language and accent color — changes apply live.
wizard_prefs_sub: Adjust window behavior to your liking — you can change all of these anytime in Settings.
wizard_prefs_note: All set! Click Get started to open the main panel.
